episodes.name: Super Hero Sketch Artist
episodes.overviewEn: Plastic Man uses his stretching abilities to help an elderly woman identify the man who stole her purse.

episodes.name: The Many and the Fowl
episodes.overviewEn: Plastic Man tries to pay his electric bill, but first has to deal with the Tuxedo, Lady Granite, and the Fowl when it comes to mailing the payment.

episodes.name: Boobtube
episodes.overviewEn: Flatscreen captures Plastic Man in a television.

episodes.name: The Bat and the Eel
episodes.overviewEn: Batman relates his encounter with safecracker Eel O'Brian.

episodes.name: Superheroes Wear Pajamas
episodes.overviewEn: Plastic Man is entranced by the Tuxedo and appears in public in his Batman pajamas with his teddy bear.

episodes.name: Untouchable
episodes.overviewEn: During a secret meeting, a mob crew begins to feel paranoid with the thought of Plastic Man being among them in disguise.
